about: A stalwart advocate for her clients throughout their arduous legal ordeals, Charlotte D. Key maintains consistency in her eminent legal representation, helping them secure their assets and legacies for their loved ones. The managing attorney at Law Office of Charlotte D. Key, PLLC, in Dallas, Texas, she manages myriad aspects of estate planning and administration matters, including wills and trusts, and probate, as well as advising as general counsel for small- and mid-sized businesses.

Ms. Key completed her undergraduate studies in 2003, graduating with her Bachelor of Science in public relations from The University of Texas at Austin, and went on to enroll in the Howard University School of Law, where she strengthened her legal acumen and talents that help her clients in their harrowing legal challenges today. Prior to receiving her Juris Doctor in 2006, she served as the senior articles editor of the Howard Law Journal and was a member of Epsilon Sigma Iota Sorority. The same year she graduated from law school, she obtained her license to practice law in California, and two years later, she became licensed to practice law in Texas. Moreover, in the state of Texas, she is certified as an attorney ad litem.

Within her legal community, Ms. Key maintains close affiliations with numerous legal organizations, including the Collin County Bar Association, the American Bar Association and the State Bar of Texas (African-American Lawyers Section, and Real Estate, Probate and Trust Section). For her many contributions, she has been rated a perfect “10.0” on Avvo, along with numerous positive testimonials on the site as well.
